About Us

Built for continuous industrial use

Influitive Automation LLP supplies and installs the full range of industrial doors, shutters, and access automation equipment used across manufacturing plants, cold storage facilities, logistics hubs, and hangars.

From a single loading bay to a complete facility fit-out, we handle specification, installation, and after-sales service so your openings keep working through every shift, every season.

01

Engineering-led

Every installation is specified against the opening, the load, and the operating environment — not sold off a catalogue.

02

End-to-end delivery

Site survey, supply, installation, and commissioning handled by one team, start to finish.

03

Ongoing service support

Scheduled maintenance and breakdown support to keep equipment running with minimal downtime.
